runner_requirements.why: Modules of CODE_B64 that read the literal /kaggle/input: kaggle/build_l0_notebooks.py lines 141-146 (LID_STRICT=1: lid_strict.json is searched under IN = FLAG_IN, which this notebook sets to the eda-bundle folder (FLAG_IN=str(eda[0].parent.parent)), so only the fallback list(Path("/kaggle/input").rglob("lid_strict.json")) finds flag2027-lid-strict-p; the original logs show that route: 'LID_STRICT MAV voice files dropped from training rows: 58 of 58 listed | /kaggle/input/datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lid-strict-p/lid_strict.json'); Experiment/T3ENC-01/run.py lines 27-36 strict_drop() (LIDSTRICT-01/lid_strict.json is not embedded, so only Path("/kaggle/input").rglob("lid_strict.json") satisfies `assert hit`); Experiment/CLEANTUNE-01/run.py _find / _find_all (lines 128-146: CT voice blocks rn293 / ecapa1024 / samS4 / aux voices, the F0 zip) and audit() line 586 (A0 check of attachments named avs / lrs3: passes vacuously when the literal path is empty); Experiment/VOICELORA-01/run.py _find (lines 44-49: VoxBlink voice blocks); Experiment/FACELORA-03/run.py adir (lines 50-56: the adapted arrays of flag2027-feats-ls-b3s-p / -ls-c5s-p); Experiment/SCALE-CC-01/run.py vox2b_dir (lines 28-35: feats_vox2b); Experiment/AUXP-01/run.py line 34, Experiment/DSEL-02/run.py lines 53-54, Experiment/DSEL-03/run.py lines 75-76 (auxiliary tables). A miss ends in an assert, in `_fill` ('stand-in blocks are for smoke tests only') or in a None path. Code decoded at run time from the base64 zip CODE_B64 is written to /kaggle/working/lab and run as lab_entry.py subprocesses; the runner's replacement of the string '/kaggle/input' in the stage code does not reach it. The literal path /kaggle/input must therefore show exactly this stage's inputs while the stage runs: e.g. a container with the virtual input mounted at /kaggle/input (as release/docker/ff.py does; FF_LITERAL_KAGGLE=mounted), or a symlink /kaggle/input -> the virtual input on a Linux host without /kaggle (the runner makes it when this flag is set). In a Kaggle notebook whose own /kaggle/input holds other attachments, run this stage in a session with exactly its inputs attached (as the original run); the runner can only warn there (FF_LITERAL_STRICT=1 makes it an error). /kaggle/input must also hold no second copy of the files these modules look for (e.g. an original saved copy of an artifact rebuilt in the session): they take the first hit of their own scan. Same wording as stages/50_eval/e112f1sx (WP-G), which carries the same modules.
